```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup build tools (CMake & vcpkg)
        uses: microsoft/onnxruntime-github-actions/setup-build-tools@v0.0.8
        with:
          cmake-version: '3.30.0'
          add-cmake-to-path: true
          vcpkg-version: '2024.10.01'
          disable-terrapin: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Cache vcpkg packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/vcpkg
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-vcpkg-${{ hashFiles('**/vcpkg.json') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-vcpkg-

      - name: Configure CMake
        uses: lukka/run-cmake@v3
        with:
          cmakeListsTxtPath: CMakeLists.txt
          cmakeBuildType: Release
          buildDirectory: build
          cmakeAppendedArgs: |
            -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=${{ env.VCPKG_ROOT }}/scripts/buildsystems/vcpkg.cmake
            -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=x64-linux
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON
            -DCMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS=OFF

      - name: Build
        uses: lukka/run-cmake@v3
        with:
          cmakeListsTxtPath: CMakeLists.txt
          cmakeBuildType: Release
          buildDirectory: build
          cmakeAppendedArgs: --build . --config Release

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd build
          ctest --output-on-failure

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: build/Testing/Temporary/LastTest.log

      - name: Lint code
        uses: super-linter/super-linter/slim@v8.3.2
        env:
          DEFAULT_BRANCH: main
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
